metadata.title: Generic Cantor actions of Z wr Z are hyperfinite

exact_claim: A dense G_delta subset of the full Polish action space Act(Z wr Z, Cantor) has hyperfinite orbit equivalence relation on the entire Cantor space. Restricted countable discrete wreath product, not an unrestricted product.
strongest_verified_claim: The generic full-space theorem and the auxiliary theorem: every Borel W-action on a standard Borel X admitting a Borel equivariant p:X->Zhat for the shift character has hyperfinite whole-space orbit relation; stabilizers allowed and p need not be onto.

independence.incidental_exposure: Current manuscript and necessary mathematical PROOF include historical status/priority/approach/failure-mode language; not adopted as verdicts. Raw-primary receipts supply provenance only. Root warned of historical ACCEPTANCE wrapper; that path was not executed.
independence.interruption_handling: Completed controls and screenshots preserved; no live23356964 process or unresolved execution handle observed on resumption; no completed check restarted solely because of interruption.

limitations: AI-assisted review only, not independent human peer review or a formal proof certificate.
Does not assert hyperfiniteness of every Borel W-action without the height factor.
Does not assert a single comeager conjugacy class, a G_delta characterization of all hyperfinite actions, or a uniform Borel choice of factors/exhaustions across the action space.
Finite quotient/prefix controls and program replays do not prove Baire category or infinite Borel hyperfiniteness; those steps are audited analytically using the exact primary imports.
Finite equivalence-relation exhaustions are Borel, not asserted clopen or continuous.
